notes: All three identities were absent from docs/data/skills.json at audit time. The Xenoverse 2 Ultimate Attack index explicitly places Self-Destruct, Zetsumei Bullet, and Cookie Beam in the cast-exclusive Strike Ultimate section and gives 300 Ki for each. No unlock method or Ultimate Finish requirement is inferred from their absence from the playable skill pool, so those fields remain null.
